turns.q: If it doesn't work out for me, what are my options?
turns.replyTail:
t are my options?

Great question! For most of our products, if it doesn't work out for you, you can return or exchange your item as long as it's unused and within our return window. There are a few exceptions, though—items like mystery boxes and Almost Perfect products are final sale and can't be returned or exchanged. International orders are also final sale.

If you have a specific item in mind, let me know and I can give you the exact details for that product!

Best, Skylar
